**0.9.0: a personal dictionary.**

- New screen, Personal dictionary (home and the side menu): add the words you want written your way, such as names, brands and Hebrew words in the spelling you use. After each take, Hebrish replaces what the model wrote with your spelling.
- Each word can have a "heard as" phrase: what Hebrish writes instead (for example Hebrish, heard as "hebrew ish"). Without one, it fixes the spelling and capitals of a word Hebrish already hears, including when the model splits it (git hub → GitHub).
- It is shared with Android's personal dictionary: words you add in your keyboard (Add to dictionary) work in Hebrish, and words you add in Hebrish show up in your keyboards. Android only allows this for an enabled keyboard, so the Hebrish voice keyboard has to be turned on in Settings (you don't have to use it). Without it, Hebrish uses the words you add in Hebrish.
- It corrects the text after it is written; it doesn't change what the model hears or slow it down. The same dictionary is in desktop 0.8.0.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
